categories.main_business_segments: Encompass Health operates two primary business segments: (1) Inpatient Rehabilitation, which includes a network of inpatient rehabilitation hospitals, and (2) Home Health and Hospice, which provides Medicare-certified skilled home health and hospice services. As of December 31, 2021, the company managed 145 inpatient rehabilitation hospitals and 347 home health and hospice locations across the U.S. and Puerto Rico.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced clinical protocols, electronic medical record technologies, data analytics, and predictive analytics to deliver care. Inpatient rehabilitation utilizes interdisciplinary teams of nurses and therapists, while home health and hospice employ registered nurses, therapists, and social workers, supported by evidence-based specialty programs and telehealth pilots. Technology-enabled care coordination and standardized best practices are central to operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Encompass Health primarily serves older adults, especially Medicare beneficiaries, who require post-acute care following significant medical events such as strokes, hip fractures, or chronic illnesses. Key customers include acute care hospitals (as referral sources), managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and patients needing facility-based or home-based rehabilitative or hospice care.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a national footprint, operating in 42 states and Puerto Rico. Inpatient rehabilitation hospitals are concentrated in the eastern U.S. and Texas, while home health and hospice agencies are present in 34 states, with a focus on the southern U.S. Recent acquisitions have expanded presence into Alaska, Montana, Washington, and Wyoming.
categories.supply_chain_position: Encompass Health operates at the downstream end of the healthcare supply chain, directly delivering patient care services in both facility-based (inpatient rehabilitation) and home-based (home health and hospice) settings. The company is a provider of post-acute healthcare services, interfacing directly with patients and referral sources.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the network of inpatient rehabilitation hospitals and home health/hospice locations, strengthening relationships with healthcare systems and payors, and enhancing integrated care delivery. The company invests in technology-driven innovation, value-based care models, clinical collaboration, and workforce recruitment/retention. R&D efforts focus on post-acute care solutions, data analytics, telehealth, and participation in alternative payment models.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through patient care services reimbursed by Medicare (traditional and Advantage), managed care plans, private insurers, Medicaid, and direct patient payments. Inpatient rehabilitation is reimbursed on a per-discharge basis under Medicare's IRF-PPS, while home health and hospice are reimbursed through episodic or per diem payments. Approximately 82% of revenue comes from Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Encompass Health is the largest owner and operator of inpatient rehabilitation hospitals in the U.S. and the fourth largest provider of Medicare-certified home health services. Key competitors include acute care hospitals with rehab units, other public and private post-acute care companies, large insurance companies with home health subsidiaries, and numerous local providers. The industry is highly fragmented, with competition based on quality, outcomes, cost, and referral relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, Encompass Health reported net operating revenues of $5.1 billion, up 10.3% from 2020. The company has demonstrated consistent growth through organic expansion and acquisitions, with strong cash flows and a well-capitalized balance sheet. As of December 31, 2021, it employed approximately 43,400 individuals and had a market capitalization of about $7.6 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Encompass Health differentiates itself through high-quality clinical outcomes, cost-effective care, extensive application of technology, and strong strategic relationships with healthcare systems. Its scale, integrated care delivery, data-driven practices, and award-winning employee culture support superior patient outcomes and operational efficiency. The company emphasizes its ability to adapt to regulatory changes and deliver value-based, patient-centered care.
